def execute_quas_wex_exort_dota(ctx, actor, target, cfg):
    # LORE INTENT: Invoker cycles ice, storm and fire elemental orbs that modify stats and determine possible invoked spells.
    if not ctx.owns_ability(actor, ability_id): return NOT_OWNED
    if not ctx.check_explicit_conditions(actor, target, cfg): return DENIED
    tx = ctx.begin_effect(ability_id, actor, target)
    zone = spawn_persistent_region(actor,target_point,shape)
    while zone.is_active:
        occupants = query_entities_entering_or_inside(zone)
        apply_defined_effects_per_occupant_tick(occupants,zone)
    on_exit_or_end: remove_only_owned_status_instances(zone)
    tx.commit_if_valid()
    ctx.emit_effect_event(ability_id)
    return SUCCESS
